preconditions.expression: isinstance(T, str) and 1 <= len(T) <= 100000 and T.islower() and T.isalpha()
preconditions.description: T is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 100000.
N is an integer between 1 and 600.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of distinct decorations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(bouquet) > 0 and bouquet in [T[i:j] for i in range(len(T)) for j in range(i+1, len(T)+1)] for bouquet in all_bouquets) and all(bouquet == bouquet[::-1] for bouquet in all_bouquets)
postconditions.description: Every bouquet in the decoration is a non-empty palindromic substring of T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(decoration) == N for decoration in all_decorations) and all(len(bouquet) > 0 for bouquet in decoration for decoration in all_decorations)
postconditions.description: Each decoration consists of exactly N bouquets, each of which is a non-empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(not (is_cyclic_shift(decoration1, decoration2) or is_reversed_cyclic_shift(decoration1, decoration2)) for i in range(len(all_decorations)) for j in range(i+1, len(all_decorations)) for decoration1 in [all_decorations[i]] for decoration2 in [all_decorations[j]])
postconditions.description: No two decorations in the set are cyclic shifts or reversed cyclic shifts of each other.

invariants.expression: all(len(bouquet) > 0 and bouquet == bouquet[::-1] for bouquet in all_bouquets)
invariants.description: All bouquets in the decoration are non-empty palindromes.

invariants.expression: all(bouquet in [T[i:j] for i in range(len(T)) for j in range(i+1, len(T)+1)] for bouquet in all_bouquets)
invariants.description: All bouquets are substrings of T.
